responsibility: Implements generation of the synthetic program scaffold that ties gm2 modules into an executable or shared object. It builds ctor-reference globals, imports and topologically orders module constructor lists from explicit use-lists or discovered imports, declares external module ctor/init/fini entry points, synthesizes `_M2_link`, `_M2_init`, `_M2_fini`, and `main` procedures with standard argument/environment parameters, and emits per-module initialization and finalization calls or ctor-array population so the linker and runtime pull in and run the required modules in the correct order.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file implements scaffold generation: it builds and orders module ctor/init/fini lists, declares externs and `_M2_*`/`main` procedures, and populates the ctor array, whereas the same-name `.def` file only exports those scaffold symbols and helper routines.
